name: Big cheque
oneLiner: an oversized foam-board presentation cheque is raised into a spotlight in front of a blurred event room: the payee, the amount, the amount spelled out in words and the memo are written on in marker on twos, a script signature signs it, then it is held up high as two camera flashes pop and a flare catches the gloss
say: when the speaker says what they won, got paid or were handed ('they handed me a cheque for ten thousand', 'that is the prize'): the amount writes in on the number and the flashes pop on the payoff
